mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical Know Sure Thing line/signal crossover identifies a reversal in the weighted consensus of four price cycles; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when KST crosses strictly above its signal SMA; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: KST combines four separately lagged and SMA-smoothed close ROCs with increasing 1:2:3:4 cycle weights, then crosses the composite against its own SMA(9). It is not one return sum, price-average crossover, regression, range path, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse multi-cycle weighted momentum/signal reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.roc: 100*(current close/close n completed bars earlier-1), n in 10,15,20,30
features.rocma: causal SMA over 10,10,10,15 observations respectively, reset by source gaps
features.event: current finite nonzero KST-signal sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical KST(10,15,20,30;10,10,10,15;9) signal crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no periods, weights, threshold, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Martin Pring canonical Know Sure Thing convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: ROC lengths 10,15,20,30; corresponding SMA lengths 10,10,10,15; weights 1,2,3,4; signal SMA 9
external_basis.selection_use: published TradingView defaults and signal crossover only; no incidence or outcomes
